component.name: Tarn
component.summary: A fast, private browser with a native interface

description.p: Tarn is a fast, private browser with a native interface on every platform. It is written in Rust, with no telemetry, no accounts and no Electron. On Linux it renders pages with WebKitGTK.

ul.li: Shield blocks trackers and ads, strips tracking parameters and keeps pages off your local network. Strict adds HTTPS-only and no cross-site referrer; Lockdown turns off JavaScript and keeps no site data. Every level can be set per site.
Blocking you can switch: ads, trackers, cookie banners, pop-ups, malware, phishing and scam sites. Lists are signed and updated daily.
Keyboard first: one field for addresses, search, open tabs and app actions, and rebindable shortcuts.
Spaces and profiles: profiles keep cookies, history and site data fully apart. Private spaces and burner tabs live in memory only.
Reader view, per-site zoom, dark mode and CSS, and full-text history search.

screenshot.caption: Site settings with the Shield level per site

description.p: Ctrl+Tab to the most recent tab with a switcher strip, an error page for invalid certificates that shows the certificate, hidden spaces, tabs in the sidebar or on top, Measure that closes with a second click or a click on the page, and file uploads for agents.

Glass design, find in page that marks every match, a local AI agent that can browse in its own window, saved assistant chats, Picture in Picture on tab switch, client certificates, one-command installs and a portable Windows build.
Fixes iOS release packaging and App Store Connect upload validation.
Livelier search bar effects and tab motion, Check Now for updates, store builds for the mobile apps, passkey and engine switches on macOS, and download notices over the page on macOS and Windows.
Search shortcuts and gentler tab sleep.
Most macOS features on Linux, Open File, tabs dragged out into a window of their own, a link status bubble, and a full interface and accessibility pass.
Redesigned interface, Tarn extensions, site icons, nightly builds and licence notices.
